svg.title: CI/CD Pipeline — SaludDeUna GitHub Actions
svg.desc: 9-stage CI/CD pipeline: Code Push to Production Deploy on AWS ECS Fargate
svg.text: Estrategia DevOps — GitHub Actions → AWS ECS Fargate
AWS Secrets: AWS_ACCESS_KEY · AWS_SECRET_KEY · ECR_REGISTRY · ECS_CLUSTER · ECS_SERVICE
App Secrets (Secrets Manager): MONGO_URI · REDIS_URL · JWT_SECRET · GEMINI_API_KEY
Deploy actual: Railway/Render (MVP) → AWS ECS Fargate (target)
Blue/Green deploy: 0 downtime · Auto-rollback on health check failure · CloudWatch alarms
